summary: V38H validated: 13/13 backend pytest passed (additional_emails on user profile, new contact birthday fields persistence, AI birthday message generation with variance across calls, tone modulation for inactive clients, delete contact + team endpoints with role authorization). Frontend UI validated on mobile viewport (390x844): login flow, Impostazioni 'Email aggiuntive' add/chip render + testIDs, Team screen shows member-del-* delete buttons, Contact edit form shows birthday config (c-bday-auto toggle, c-bday-active, sender pills c-bday-from-<em>, recipient pills c-bday-to-<em>, c-bday-generate-ai button) and c-delete-btn at bottom. No console errors observed.
action_items: None — all V38H acceptance criteria met on both backend and frontend.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py > 4900 lines; ok but recommend eventual split into modules (auth, contacts, bills, ai, team).
AI generate endpoint runs synchronously (~5-15s). Ingress default 60s is fine, but consider adding a timeout + retry hint on frontend if user's network stalls.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, impostazioni email chip, team delete list, contact edit birthday config + delete button all verified)

seed_data_creation: Test creates & cleans up temporary contacts (Marco/Luigi TEST_V38H*) and team members (TEST_A, TEST_B, TEST_V38H_TEAM) automatically. UI tests also create+delete their own contacts. No leftover data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: V38H complete. Auth token in localStorage key is `auth_token_v1` (JSON-encoded string). Contact create returns `contact_id` (not id). /api/auth/me wraps user under `user` key. /api/team accepts {email,name,password,areas} (no `role` field — role always becomes 'member'). Backend AI endpoint POST /api/contacts/{cid}/birthday/generate-message uses Claude Sonnet 5 via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, returns {message, year, is_active_client}. Second call reliably varies output.
